changelog: Adds YouTube, Rumble and Both video source selection in the new Rumble + Bunny sync TV settings panel
Includes a sidebar for locally followed Rumble channels and phone-to-TV pairing with a 10-digit code
Uses direct HLS/MP4 playback with alternate stream fallback for Rumble videos
Bunny server and Rumble API activation are required before cloud sync or Rumble discovery works
Preserves SmartTube YouTube playback, rollback recovery, signed updates and Google TV Streamer-compatible ARMv7/Universal APKs
Adds YouTube, Rumble and Both to the main TV sidebar
Shows Rumble alongside YouTube on Home in Both mode
Uses followed Rumble channels or live videos when you have no follows
Requests Android media audio focus for Rumble playback
Adds Follow on Rumble to the YouTube player controls
Choose a matching Rumble channel to save it to your synced SmartTube follows
Home shows recent videos from YouTube subscriptions and followed Rumble channels, newest first where dates are available
Rumble cards show the channel name and upload date when available
Both mixes YouTube and matching Rumble videos in each category, including creators you do not follow
Home uses the same mixed YouTube and Rumble categories as Both
Videos wrap into a vertical grid so you can scroll down through each category
Recent uploads from both services appear first, newest first where dates are available
Adds a high-contrast frame around the focused TV video card and rounds the card corners
Shows a YouTube or Rumble icon in the top-right of each video thumbnail
Keeps titles visible below the thumbnails
Uses Android rounding for video cards while keeping the focus frame, titles and source icons
Falls back to subscriptions or Trending if YouTube recommendations come back empty
Shows available YouTube videos without waiting for Rumble, and keeps looking for saved Rumble results after an allowance error
Starts on the first video in Recent from your channels when available
Shows 19 recent videos before the next section, with Show more revealing up to 19 additional videos per click
Improves YouTube playback when SABR authentication briefly fails
Recovers from repeatedly stalled streams sooner
Preserves Rumble, sync, TV buffering and your DNS preference
Suggestions prioritize the watched subject, with channel as a tie-breaker
News prefers Sweden/Swedish coverage with an English breaking-news fallback; Thai news is filtered
Memory-aware temporary VOD read-ahead scales toward 500 MB only where heap capacity permits; live buffering stays short and consumed buffers are discarded
Adds Related videos to the TV player controls, opening suggestions below the watched video with the remote
Keeps strong subject matches first and allows relevant title variation; channel only breaks equal subject scores
Shows a focusable retry card when related videos are loading or unavailable, and retains results arriving before player rows initialize
Preserves Sweden/Swedish or English breaking news, adaptive temporary buffering, SABR recovery, Rumble and sync
Fixes the news section stopping after one Swedish video; fills from multiple preferred news sources
Uses Swedish/Sweden searches and English breaking-news searches from recognized publishers, independent of device location
Applies a working Today search filter, rejects old clips and Thai results, and removes duplicate videos
Targets up to 24 news videos per language with a limit of eight per publisher; actual availability varies
Preserves related videos below the player, playback recovery, adaptive temporary buffering, Rumble and sync
